scenario.shared_setting: Four colleagues work together in a small team and have done so for a year. Tomorrow, Wednesday, is the last day for a fifth colleague, who is not here, and the four are taking her out for a farewell lunch. You all know each other's faith: Daniel Pereira is Catholic, Hafiz is Muslim, Wei Ming is Buddhist, and Karthik is Hindu. It is late afternoon, and all four are at their desks.
scenario.shared_trigger: Daniel Pereira has just told the others that the farewell lunch tomorrow is booked at a Korean barbecue restaurant near the office, where pork and beef are grilled at each table and the meats come marinated. The colleague who is leaving chose it herself. Nothing has been paid for. Nobody has said anything about it yet.
scenario.title: Farewell lunch: Hindu, one of each culture
